title: Manager terminals 5: open and close a project from the command
notes: Part of the parent card 'Manager terminals: ask the dashboard about any project and dispatch work into it'. dashboard project open|close <name|aka>. Close uses the app's own refusal: refused while any pane in the project is busy, naming it; otherwise closes with no confirm dialog. Open adds the page the way the project picker does.

comments.body: PR #159: dashboard project open|close <name|aka>. After #158 merged: one open step (openProject in main.ts) and one name lookup (projectNamed in project-named.ts, now also refusing a relative path) serve the picker, pane claim --project and project open/close; project-requests.ts wraps sessionRequests on the session socket.
Shipped in PR #159: dashboard project open|close <name|aka>; close refuses while any pane is busy, otherwise closes with no dialog. Open and name lookup shared with #158 (openProject, projectNamed).
